verses.ijazatun-an-maliki-l-hawwabi-c1-v1: ʾijāzatu ʿan māliki l-ḥawwābi liḥibbihi mūsā bilā rtiyābi
verses.ijazatun-an-maliki-l-hawwabi-c1-v2: ʿan khālihi washaykhihi l-maʿlūmi ʿan sayyidī ʿumara dhī l-ʿulūmi
verses.ijazatun-an-maliki-l-hawwabi-c1-v3: ʿan sayyidī l-ghālī ʿani l-makhtūmi l-barzakhi l-quṭbi r-riḍā l-maktūmi
verses.ijazatun-an-maliki-l-hawwabi-c1-v4: ʿani n-nabiyyī l-mājidi l-ʾathīli ʿan sayyidī l-ʾamīni jabrāʾīli
verses.ijazatun-an-maliki-l-hawwabi-c1-v5: ʿani l-ʿalīmi l-māliki sh-shakūri rabbi l-ʾanāmi l-qādiri l-ghafūri
verses.ijazatun-an-maliki-l-hawwabi-c1-v6: jaddada lī shaykhī muḥammad ʿāli ʿan sayyidī mawlūda dhī l-maʿālī
verses.ijazatun-an-maliki-l-hawwabi-c1-v7: ʿan shaykhinā l-ḥāfiẓi ʿan rabbānī shaykhi sh-shuyūkhi ʾaḥmada t-tijānī
